messages:
sara_sales: quick q — procurement says they need a signed MSA + PO before kickoff for the Acme POC. can we start any work if we only have an e-signed order form and the MSA in redlines?

mike_eng: we can spin up infra with the order form alone (dev/dev testing), but dedicated capacity + on-prem options require countersigned MSA for compliance. depends on risk tolerance.

ana_procure: @sara_sales finance will not release funds without a PO on file. also legal flagged DPA redlines (EU data residency & subprocessors). can the sales order include a PO placeholder so we can provision while legal finishes the MSA?

josh_legal: we can accept a signed OF for kickoff if the OF has an explicit acceptance clause that POC work is limited and non-production. we need to capture the PO number in the invoice and an SLA carveout for POC (no SLO credits during eval period).

sara_sales: okay — so two paths: (A) allow OF + PO placeholder for bootstrapping infra, or (B) wait for countersigned MSA/DPA for full Dedicated. which is easiest?

mike_eng: A is easiest operationally. we'll tag the deployment as `poc-eval` and enable a hard stop at 30 days unless MSA countersigned. no customer data landing in persistent KVS until DPA approved.

ana_procure: finance asked for invoice example to attach to the PO. added here:
```
Invoice:
  PO: PO-987654
  SOW: POC-Acme-30d
  Amount: $18,000
  Billing terms: Net30
```

sara_sales: FYI customer procurement insists on Net45 and paper signature for MSA. they say DocuSign is not allowed for legal team. any workaround?

josh_legal: if they refuse DocuSign, we can offer a scanned wet-ink copy routed through our legal ops. note: that adds ~5 business days to timeline. also we need the DPA subprocessors list approved — attach to the MSA as exhibit.

docsign-bot: envelope 0x9f4 created for orderform (sara_sales -> acme-signer). status: waiting on recipient.

ana_procure: if wet-ink required, can we accept an interim e-signed OF to start infra and then require wet-ink MSA before production billing? procurement prefers that split.

mike_eng: yes, we can. add a flag `do_not_prod` on the tenant. we'll also disable backups until MSA countersigned (per legal).

sara_sales: @josh_legal please confirm language we should add to the OF to protect us during interim start (liability cap, no SLA credits, limited data use).

josh_legal: propose this short clause to insert in OF: "POC work is limited to evaluation; Redwood's production SLAs, availability commitments, and liability caps are not in effect until a fully executed MSA is in place. Customer consents to data handling per attached DPA draft for evaluation-only processing." Use that + exhibit ref to subprocessors.

ana_procure: noted. also need billing contact + remit to on the invoice. can you add `finance@acme.co` as remit?
sara_sales: added in OF draft. final ask — customer wants KMS key control assurance: they asked if we can bring-your-own-key for the POC.

mike_eng: we can support BYOK for Dedicated, not for hosted trial. for POC on dedicated hardware we can arrange a KMS key wrap; that'll require a KMS addendum and HSM checklist. adds ops time.

josh_legal: log that as a security requirement in the MSA redlines. also customer requested a 60-day data deletion window post-POC — we can do 30 by default, 60 if requested in the DPA exhibit.

sara_sales: thanks. next steps: 1) I will send interim OF with the proposed POC clause + PO placeholder 2) @docsign-bot send OF by EOD 3) @josh_legal upload DPA subprocessors list + BYOK addendum 4) @ana_procure confirm finance remit details and Net terms.

ana_procure: confirmed remit finance@acme.co and Net45 acceptance pending exec approval.

mike_eng: tagging ops: once OF signed we'll provision `poc-eval` tenant with do_not_prod flag. ops will await wet-ink MSA before any production migration.

sara_sales: perfect — I'll update the customer and try to get their exec approval on Net45 today. :thumbsup:
